sentences.text:
Vinod Thakur vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 27
September, 2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Jbp:49800
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Jabalpur

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Ramkumar Choubey
 On The 27th Of September, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 44091 of 2025
 Vinod Thakur
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Ms. Sakshi Saxena - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Kn Nayak- Panel Lawyer for the State.
 Shri Sahil Dubey- Advocate for the objector.

Order 
This is first bail application filed on behalf of present applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

2. The applicant is in jail since 30.08.2025 in connection with Crime No.43 of 2024 registered at P.S. Amarwara District Chhindwara for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376,
376(2)(n) of IPC and Sections 3/4, 5(j)(ii)/6, 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
3 . Prosecution story, in brief, is that applicant committed sexual assault on minor prosecutrix.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the matter.
It is further submitted the prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Section 183 of BNSS has stated nothing against the present applicant.
It is further submitted that the applicant is in custody NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:49800 2 MCRC-44091-2025 since 30.8.2025.
On above grounds, it is urged that applicant be released on bail.
5. Learned counsel for the objector has submitted that the complainant has no objection if bail is granted to the applicant.
6. Learned counsel for the State, on the other hand, has opposed the application.

sentences.text: Looking to overall facts and circumstances of the case and without commenting on the merits of the case, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.

8. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
9. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
10. Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
